PurposeEn: Turns off pointer acceleration; sets speed to 20 and scrolling to 6 lines.

PurposeEn: Repeat delay 140 ms, interval 16 ms; turns off Sticky Keys, SlowKeys, BounceKeys and accessibility key alerts.

PurposeZh: 使用系统设置中的第二个黑色样式，大小设为 3。
PurposeEn: Uses the second, black pointer style in Windows Settings at size 3.

PurposeZh: 系统和应用使用浅色主题，关闭透明效果。
PurposeEn: Uses light mode for Windows and apps, with transparency disabled.

PurposeZh: 仅保留平滑字体边缘、拖动时显示窗口内容、显示缩略图。
PurposeEn: Keeps font smoothing, window contents while dragging and thumbnails.

PurposeZh: 启用“使用 Unicode UTF-8 提供全球语言支持”。
PurposeEn: Enables Unicode UTF-8 for worldwide language support.

PurposeZh: 仅保留微信输入法，从输入列表移除微软拼音和其他输入方式。
PurposeEn: Keeps WeType as the only input method, removing Microsoft Pinyin and other input methods.

PurposeZh: 插电与电池均不自动息屏、睡眠或休眠；电源按钮、睡眠按钮与合盖均无操作。
PurposeEn: No display timeout, sleep or hibernation on AC or battery; power button, sleep button and lid do nothing.

PurposeZh: 关闭休眠能力并移除 hiberfil.sys，同时关闭依赖休眠的快速启动；不影响虚拟内存。
PurposeEn: Disables hibernation and its hiberfil.sys file, including Fast Startup; virtual memory is unaffected.

PurposeZh: 隐藏最近使用与推荐，全部应用使用列表，清空固定区。 保留设置界面的手动控制。
PurposeEn: Hides recent items and recommendations, uses an app list and clears pinned apps. Keeps manual controls available in Settings.

PurposeZh: 桌面仅保留此电脑与回收站；其他文件和快捷方式移入回收站。
PurposeEn: Keeps only This PC and Recycle Bin on the desktop; moves other files and shortcuts to Recycle Bin.

PurposeZh: 开始菜单与任务栏靠左；主屏与其他屏幕仅在任务栏已满时合并按钮。
PurposeEn: Aligns Start and taskbar left; combines buttons only when full on all displays.

Zh: 任务栏搜索与任务视图
PurposeZh: 隐藏任务栏搜索和桌面切换按钮。
PurposeEn: Hides the taskbar Search and Task View buttons.

PurposeZh: 清空 Windows 保存的任务栏固定项，仍可从 Windows 界面重新固定应用。
PurposeEn: Clears saved taskbar pins while allowing applications to be pinned again.

PurposeZh: 展开当前以及新增、更新后的应用托盘图标。
PurposeEn: Shows all app tray icons, including newly added or updated icons.

PurposeZh: 隐藏任务栏中的蓝牙图标。
PurposeEn: Hides the Bluetooth icon from the system tray.

PurposeZh: 隐藏浮动语言栏和任务栏输入指示器。
PurposeEn: Hides the floating language bar and taskbar input indicator.

Zh: 文件扩展名与隐藏文件
PurposeZh: 显示文件扩展名与普通隐藏文件；受保护的系统文件继续隐藏。
PurposeEn: Shows file extensions and ordinary hidden files; keeps protected system files hidden.

PurposeZh: 文件资源管理器默认打开此电脑，保留 Windows 的文件夹显示方式。
PurposeEn: Opens File Explorer at This PC without forcing folders to be hidden.

PurposeZh: 创建快捷方式时不添加“快捷方式”后缀。
PurposeEn: Creates shortcuts without the Shortcut suffix.

PurposeZh: 在 Windows 10 经典菜单与 Windows 11 菜单之间切换。
PurposeEn: Switches between the Windows 10 classic menu and the Windows 11 menu.

PurposeZh: 使用图片背景，保留 Windows 聚焦与背景设置的选择。
PurposeEn: Uses a picture background while preserving Spotlight and background choices.

PurposeZh: 关闭锁屏聚焦，保留锁屏背景的手动选择。
PurposeEn: Turns off lock screen Spotlight while preserving manual background choices.

PurposeZh: 通过虚拟化隔离敏感系统数据。
PurposeEn: Isolates sensitive system data using virtualization.

PurposeZh: 检查内核代码完整性，限制不可信驱动执行。
PurposeEn: Checks kernel code integrity and blocks untrusted drivers.

PurposeZh: 隔离登录凭据，降低凭据被窃取的风险。
PurposeEn: Isolates sign-in credentials to reduce credential theft.

PurposeZh: 关闭 LSA 启动保护，重启后检查 LSASS 实际保护级别；不停止当前登录进程。
PurposeEn: Disables LSA protection for the next boot and verifies the live protection level; does not stop LSASS.

PurposeZh: 保护内核调用栈，阻止返回地址被篡改。
PurposeEn: Protects kernel return addresses against tampering.

PurposeZh: 在启动时检查系统完整性，建立受保护的执行环境。
PurposeEn: Checks system integrity at startup and establishes a protected environment.

PurposeZh: 阻止已知存在漏洞的驱动加载。
PurposeEn: Blocks drivers with known security vulnerabilities.

PurposeZh: 提醒危险的密码输入、密码重复使用及不安全的密码保存。
PurposeEn: Warns about unsafe password entry, password reuse and unsafe password storage.

PurposeZh: 汇总杀毒、防火墙等防护状态，供安全中心显示。
PurposeEn: Collects antivirus and firewall status for the security app.

PurposeZh: 缓解 Spectre、Meltdown 等推测执行漏洞。
PurposeEn: Mitigates speculative execution flaws such as Spectre and Meltdown.

PurposeZh: 关闭全局及当前 Windows 可执行文件的启动保护配置，包括 CET 和重定向检查；重启生效。64 位 DEP 等强制保护可能保留，检测同时显示实际运行状态。
PurposeEn: Disables global and current Windows image startup mitigations, including CET and redirection checks, after restart. Mandatory protections such as 64-bit DEP may remain; checks include live state.

PurposeZh: 阻止从数据内存页执行代码。
PurposeEn: Prevents executable code from running in data memory pages.

Zh: 异常处理与服务进程保护
PurposeZh: 保护异常处理链和系统服务进程。
PurposeEn: Protects exception chains and system service processes.

PurposeZh: 写入禁用驱动完整性检查的启动参数，重启后检查实际内核状态；Secure Boot 或 Windows 自身约束可能仍保留检查。
PurposeEn: Disables boot integrity checks and verifies live kernel state after restart; Secure Boot or Windows restrictions may retain enforcement.

PurposeZh: 将 Windows Time 设为自动启动并立即运行，移除服务触发器，保留现有校时服务器；可在服务管理中修改。
PurposeEn: Sets Windows Time to Automatic and starts it, removing service triggers while keeping the time server; editable in Services.

PurposeZh: 将系统更新暂停期限设为 7000 天，保留更新页面与手动恢复更新的能力。
PurposeEn: Pauses updates for 7000 days while keeping Windows Update available for manual use.

PurposeZh: 排除 Windows Update 质量更新中的驱动，并关闭设备安装时的在线驱动搜索；仍可手动安装驱动。
PurposeEn: Excludes drivers from Windows quality updates and turns off online device setup searches; manual driver installation remains available.

PurposeZh: 关闭所有磁盘的系统保护，停止自动创建还原点，保留系统属性中的重新开启入口。
PurposeEn: Turns off System Protection on all drives and stops automatic restore point creation while preserving the controls to enable it again.

PurposeZh: 在符合条件的设备上自动启用磁盘加密。
PurposeEn: Encrypts drives automatically on eligible devices.

PurposeZh: 关闭可选诊断数据、遥测服务和相关计划任务；不终止当前服务，重启生效。
PurposeEn: Disables optional diagnostics, telemetry services and their scheduled tasks without stopping current services; restart to apply.

PurposeZh: 关闭广告标识与个性化推荐，保留隐私设置的手动开关。
PurposeEn: Turns off advertising ID and tailored experiences while keeping privacy controls available.

PurposeZh: 显示系统推广、欢迎页面、设置建议与账户提醒。
PurposeEn: Shows promotions, welcome screens, Settings suggestions and account reminders.

PurposeZh: 记录程序启动频率，个性化开始菜单与搜索排序。
PurposeEn: Tracks app launch frequency to personalize Start and search ranking.

PurposeZh: 关闭体验反馈邀请，保留诊断与反馈设置的手动选择。
PurposeEn: Turns off feedback requests while preserving Diagnostics and Feedback choices.

PurposeZh: 关闭位置访问及应用请求位置的通知，保留 Windows 设置中的手动开关。
PurposeEn: Turns off location access and location request notifications while keeping the Windows Settings switches available.

PurposeZh: 监测系统卡顿等性能问题并记录诊断日志。
PurposeEn: Monitors performance problems such as sluggishness and records diagnostic logs.

PurposeZh: 收集使用情况与体验质量数据，用于体验改进和自愈。
PurposeEn: Collects usage and experience quality data for improvements and self-healing.

PurposeZh: 在移除智能卡时执行锁定或注销策略。
PurposeEn: Locks or signs out when a smart card is removed.

PurposeZh: 关闭搜索热点，允许从搜索设置重新开启。
PurposeEn: Turns off search highlights; users can enable them again in Search settings.

PurposeEn: Hides the Widgets button while preserving the taskbar switch.

PurposeZh: 在后台建立文件索引，加快文件内容搜索。
PurposeEn: Indexes files in the background for faster content searches.

PurposeEn: Disables application prefetching, prelaunch and operation recording, restoring automatic SysMain startup. Retains Windows memory compression and page combining settings.

PurposeZh: 监测应用兼容性并显示兼容性提示。
PurposeEn: Monitors app compatibility and displays compatibility prompts.

PurposeZh: 自动检测和排查系统问题。 禁用后续启动，当前服务保留到重启。
PurposeEn: Automatically detects and troubleshoots system problems. Future starts are disabled; current services remain until restart.

PurposeZh: 为自动诊断运行后台服务。 禁用后续启动，当前服务保留到重启。
PurposeEn: Hosts background services for automatic diagnostics. Future starts are disabled; current services remain until restart.

PurposeZh: 为自动诊断运行系统服务。 禁用后续启动，当前服务保留到重启。
PurposeEn: Hosts system services for automatic diagnostics. Future starts are disabled; current services remain until restart.

PurposeZh: 运行自动诊断和故障排查。 禁用后续启动，当前服务保留到重启。
PurposeEn: Runs automatic diagnostics and troubleshooting. Future starts are disabled; current services remain until restart.

PurposeZh: 关闭清单采集服务，解除强制策略，可通过服务管理器恢复。
PurposeEn: Disables the inventory service, removes forced policy and allows restoration through Services.

Zh: 备份与文件历史记录用户控制
PurposeZh: 解除旧版对备份、文件历史记录和设置同步的锁定，由 Windows 界面管理备份。
PurposeEn: Removes old restrictions on backup, File History and settings sync; Windows manages backup choices.

PurposeZh: 解除旧版对活动历史、AI、OneDrive、Edge 更新和家庭/Xbox 组件的额外限制。
PurposeEn: Removes old restrictions on activity history, AI, OneDrive, Edge and family/Xbox components.

PurposeZh: 关闭从其他设备下载，保留正常下载和 Windows 设置中的手动开关。
PurposeEn: Turns off peer downloads while preserving normal downloads and the Windows Settings switch.

PurposeZh: 关闭远程桌面，保留服务供 Windows 设置手动开启。
PurposeEn: Turns off Remote Desktop while keeping its services available for manual use.

PurposeZh: 关闭远程协助，保留系统属性中的手动开关。

PurposeEn: Turns off cross-device resume and removes old policy and execution restrictions while preserving manual controls.

PurposeZh: 关闭剪贴板历史，保留剪贴板服务及手动开关。
PurposeEn: Turns off clipboard history while keeping its service and manual switch available.

PurposeZh: 关闭游戏录制，保留录制服务及捕获设置中的开关。
PurposeEn: Turns off game capture while keeping its service and manual capture controls available.

PurposeZh: 提供 Recall 屏幕快照与历史回顾功能。
PurposeEn: Provides Recall snapshots and activity history.

PurposeZh: 关机时保存内核会话，加快下次启动。
PurposeEn: Saves the kernel session at shutdown for faster startup.

PurposeZh: 为系统更新和临时文件预留磁盘空间。
PurposeEn: Reserves disk space for system updates and temporary files.

PurposeZh: 提供可覆盖的默认关闭值，用户可在 Edge 设置中修改预启动和后台运行。
PurposeEn: Sets overridable off defaults for startup boost and background mode; users can change them in Edge Settings.

PurposeZh: 关闭 Windows 搜索的联网建议与网页结果；保留本地搜索，不拦截 SearchHost 或卸载商店。商店结果能否独立保留取决于 Windows 版本。
PurposeEn: Disables online suggestions and web results without blocking SearchHost, local search or Store. Separate Store results depend on Windows version.

Zh: 联系人与用户数据后台
PurposeZh: 禁用联系人索引及用户数据存储、访问服务的后续启动，重启生效；使用这些服务的联系人或日历应用将不可同步。
PurposeEn: Disables future starts of contact indexing and user data storage/access services after restart; apps relying on these services cannot sync contacts or calendars.

PurposeZh: 禁用打印后台及打印工作流用户服务的后续启动，重启生效；实体打印和打印到 PDF 均不再可用。
PurposeEn: Disables print spooler and per-user print workflow services after restart, including physical printing and Print to PDF.

PurposeZh: 关闭 SSDP、UPnP、网络功能发现及 WPS 配置服务；保留 USB 即插即用、无线网络和蓝牙，重启生效。
PurposeEn: Disables SSDP, UPnP, network function discovery and WPS configuration after restart; preserves USB Plug and Play, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth.

PurposeZh: 禁用网络流量统计服务的后续启动；保留网络连接和流量传输，重启生效。
PurposeEn: Disables future starts of data usage reporting after restart, preserving networking and traffic transmission.

PurposeZh: 保留右下角通知弹窗、声音及推送服务；关闭通知中心侧栏、锁屏通知、任务栏通知徽章与系统建议。通知中心策略重启生效，不修改各应用自己的通知和声音选择。
PurposeEn: Keeps notification banners, sounds and push services; disables the notification center sidebar, lock-screen notifications, taskbar badges and Windows suggestions. The notification center policy takes effect after restart; individual app notification and sound choices are preserved.
